in_arabic.name: عائشة
in_arabic.long_meaning: The one who is alive, living, and lively. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'A-A-Sh-A', which means 'to live'. It is also the name of one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).
